string.text: Break the Roadblock

Two enemy groups have fortified one of the routes. They search everyone passing through and have already disrupted several deliveries. Clear both groups. The pay is modest; the job is simple only on paper.
Locate the enemy roadblock and eliminate both groups holding it.
The route is open again. Here is the agreed amount.
Intercept the Column
Recon spotted two enemy groups moving along the same route. If they reach their allies, this direction will become troublesome. Intercept both groups at their rally point.
Intercept two enemy groups and stop them from crossing the area.
The column never arrived. Good work.
Broken Deal
Two armed groups are meeting on neutral ground. Both are a problem, and they will scatter after the deal. Hit the meeting while everyone is still gathered.
Clear the meeting point of both hostile groups.
No deal and no participants. Exactly what we needed.
Two Sectors
The enemy split up and occupied two positions. Remove one group and the other will dig in. Clear both sectors as part of the same operation.
Eliminate the enemy squads occupying two separate sectors.
Both positions are clear. We can move through the area again.
Experienced Cell
Two well-equipped enemy groups are preparing to reinforce nearby positions. These are not rookies around a campfire: they move carefully and keep their weapons ready. Eliminate both groups.
Track down and eliminate two experienced enemy groups.
So they were not untouchable after all. Here is your payment.
Operation Cleanup
Too many armed hostiles have gathered in one area. A single precise hit will change nothing; the whole node must be broken at once. Bring enough ammunition. The fight will be dense.
Clear a fortified area occupied by three enemy groups.
After that cleanup, they will not return soon.
False Signal
Someone is broadcasting fake stash coordinates and luring stalkers into a prepared ambush. Two groups operate at the suspected location. Go there and silence them.
Investigate the false signal and eliminate both ambush groups.
The channel is quiet again. A small payment for useful work.
Deep Raid

This job is for someone who can survive far from familiar bases. Two strong groups have established themselves deeper in the Zone. The road is long, the enemy is experienced, and there will be no support.
Conduct a deep raid and eliminate two reinforced enemy groups.
You came back, which is already something. Since the target is gone, take the full payment.
